escena: SCENE (cinematic, a real SIX-SECOND long-exposure photograph taken on a tripod in a dark film studio at night, during the shooting of a short product ad): a Latin American art director in his late thirties, short dark hair and a trimmed beard, wearing the Efeonce hoodie exactly as in its reference, stands perfectly still and SHARP slightly RIGHT of center in the lower part of the frame, framed from the waist up, looking straight into the lens with calm, exacting focus. In his open right hand, at chest height, he holds a fictitious faceted glass perfume bottle with NO label and NO lettering, perfectly still and razor sharp, its single specular highlight crisp: the only detail in the whole frame that did not move. Everything else moved during the six seconds and is written in light: a moving light on a motion-control arm painted ONE long continuous, smooth vivid orange (#FF6500) light trail that sweeps in a wide arc around the bottle, behind his shoulder and back, like the path of the camera move of the ad; two crew members walking past behind him are rendered as soft translucent ghosts with long blur; a camera dolly in the background is a smear of dark motion. LIGHT: the orange trail is the brightest element of the frame and the only key light: it paints the bottle, his hand and one side of his face warm orange, the far side of his face in shadow; NO fill light. A cool azure (#0375DB) rim light from behind outlines his head and shoulders. Thin haze catches the trail. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two meters away at chest height, 85mm, nothing foreshortened, he does not lean toward the lens. Real long-exposure physics: genuine motion blur, real sensor grain, fine dust in the haze, slight chromatic aberration on the brightest edges. The TOP 30% of the frame is calm, deep dark studio space with only faint haze, no trail, no light, no objects; the trail stays below 34% of the frame height. Enormous contrast, deep navy blacks. No readable text, no letters, no logos of any brand.

lecho.objeto: the near-black matte edge of a director's monitor cart close to the lens across the whole bottom of the frame, completely out of focus, outside every light and every reflection

texto.muro: calm, deep dark studio space with only faint haze
